units.vi: Bổ sung Movers 1: gia đình, cơ thể, sức khoẻ

words.en: a mother or father
words.ex: Every parent wants their child to be happy.
words.exVi: Bố mẹ nào cũng muốn con mình hạnh phúc.

cloze.s: My mother is a teacher. My other ___ is a doctor.

exam.s: One parent must come to the meeting.

words.en: a grandmother or grandfather
words.ex: I visit my grandparents every Sunday.
words.exVi: Chủ nhật nào tôi cũng thăm ông bà.

cloze.s: My grandmother is my favourite ___.

exam.s: Which grandparent lives with you?

words.en: the son of your son or daughter
words.ex: My grandmother plays chess with her grandson.
words.exVi: Bà tôi chơi cờ với cháu trai.

cloze.s: Mr Lam has one ___ and two granddaughters.

exam.s: His grandson is five years old.

words.en: the daughter of your son or daughter
words.ex: Her granddaughter lives in Hanoi.
words.exVi: Cháu gái của bà sống ở Hà Nội.

cloze.s: Grandpa bought a doll for his ___.

exam.s: My granddaughter can swim.

words.en: more than one tooth
words.ex: Brush your teeth before bed.
words.exVi: Đánh răng trước khi đi ngủ.

cloze.s: I brush my ___ twice a day.

exam.s: The baby has got two teeth.

words.en: hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
words.ex: My uncle has a long grey beard.
words.exVi: Chú tôi có bộ râu dài màu xám.

cloze.s: Santa Claus has a white ___.

exam.s: The man with the beard is my dad.

words.en: hair that grows above a man's top lip
words.ex: He has a small black moustache.
words.exVi: Anh ấy có bộ ria mép nhỏ màu đen.

cloze.s: He has a ___ but no beard.

exam.s: My grandpa has a big moustache.

words.en: to push air out of your throat with a noise, often when you are ill
words.ex: I have a bad cough today.
words.exVi: Hôm nay tôi ho nặng.

cloze.s: She has a cold and a ___.

exam.s: The boy has got a cough.

words.en: a pain in your stomach
words.ex: I ate too much and now I have a stomach-ache.
words.exVi: Tôi ăn nhiều quá giờ bị đau bụng.

cloze.s: Don't eat so fast or you'll get a ___.

exam.s: She can't eat. She has a stomach-ache.

words.en: a pain inside your ear
words.ex: The music is too loud. I've got earache.
words.exVi: Nhạc to quá. Tôi bị đau tai.

cloze.s: He went to the doctor because of his ___.

bad: have got an ear pain ache

exam.s: My son has earache today.

units.vi: Bổ sung Movers 2: đồ dùng và nơi chốn

words.en: a small brush for cleaning your teeth
words.ex: Don't forget your toothbrush.
words.exVi: Đừng quên bàn chải đánh răng.

cloze.s: I need a new ___. This one is old.

exam.s: My toothbrush is blue.

words.en: a thick cream you put on a toothbrush
words.ex: We need to buy some toothpaste.
words.exVi: Chúng ta cần mua kem đánh răng.

cloze.s: Put a little ___ on your toothbrush.

exam.s: There is no toothpaste in the bathroom.

words.en: a thick cover that keeps you warm in bed
words.ex: It's cold. Can I have another blanket?
words.exVi: Lạnh quá. Cho tôi thêm một cái chăn được không?

cloze.s: In winter I sleep under a thick ___.

exam.s: The cat is sleeping on my blanket.

words.en: a long piece of cloth you wear round your neck
words.ex: Wear your scarf. It's windy.
words.exVi: Quàng khăn vào. Trời gió đấy.

cloze.s: My neck is cold. Where is my ___?

exam.s: She has a red scarf.

words.en: a hard hat that keeps your head safe
words.ex: Always wear a helmet on a motorbike.
words.exVi: Luôn đội mũ bảo hiểm khi đi xe máy.

cloze.s: Put on your ___ before you ride.

exam.s: Where is your helmet?

words.en: clothes you wear for swimming
words.ex: Take your swimsuit to the beach.
words.exVi: Mang đồ bơi đi biển nhé.

cloze.s: I can't swim today. I forgot my ___.

exam.s: Her swimsuit is yellow.

words.en: a room or floor under the ground in a building
words.ex: We keep our bikes in the basement.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi để xe đạp dưới tầng hầm.

cloze.s: The car park is in the ___ of the building.

exam.s: The basement is dark and cold.

words.en: a place where many buses start and finish their journeys
words.ex: The bus station is near the market.
words.exVi: Bến xe ở gần chợ.

cloze.s: Let's meet at the ___ at nine.

exam.s: Is the bus station far from here?

words.en: land outside towns and cities, with fields and farms
words.ex: My grandparents live in the countryside.
words.exVi: Ông bà tôi sống ở quê.

cloze.s: The air is fresh in the ___.

exam.s: We had a picnic in the countryside.

words.en: a flat green part of a plant or tree
words.ex: A leaf fell on my head.
words.exVi: Một chiếc lá rơi lên đầu tôi.

cloze.s: In autumn, every ___ on the tree turns yellow.

exam.s: The caterpillar is eating a leaf.

units.vi: Bổ sung Movers 3: hỏi, cách làm, cảm giác

words.en: used to ask about a price or an amount
words.ex: How much is this T-shirt?
words.exVi: Cái áo phông này bao nhiêu tiền?

cloze.s: ___ water do you drink every day?

exam.s: How much are the apples?

words.en: used to ask how many times something happens
words.ex: How often do you go to the gym?
words.exVi: Bao lâu bạn đi tập gym một lần?

cloze.s: ___ do you see your grandparents? Every week.

exam.s: How often do you play tennis?

words.vi: có tên là, được gọi là
words.en: to have a particular name
words.ex: My dog is called Lucky.
words.exVi: Con chó của tôi tên là Lucky.

cloze.s: This street ___ Le Loi Street.

exam.s: The film is called Big Fish.

words.en: to go to shops to buy things
words.ex: We go shopping on Saturday morning.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi đi mua sắm vào sáng thứ Bảy.

cloze.s: I need new shoes. Let's ___ after work.

exam.s: Mum likes to go shopping at the market.

words.en: in a way that avoids mistakes or danger
words.ex: Read the question carefully.
words.exVi: Đọc câu hỏi thật cẩn thận.

cloze.s: Drive ___. The road is wet.

exam.s: Please carry the glasses carefully.

words.en: not well
words.ex: I played badly in the match.
words.exVi: Tôi chơi kém trong trận đấu.

cloze.s: He sings very ___. Please stop!

exam.s: She did badly in the test.

words.en: sleeping
words.ex: Be quiet. The baby is asleep.
words.exVi: Im lặng nào. Em bé đang ngủ.

cloze.s: Grandpa is ___ on the sofa.

exam.s: The children are asleep now.

words.en: not sleeping
words.ex: I was awake at three in the morning.
words.exVi: Tôi còn thức lúc ba giờ sáng.

cloze.s: Is the baby ___ or asleep?

exam.s: Are you awake?

words.en: afraid
words.ex: My sister is frightened of dogs.
words.exVi: Em gái tôi sợ chó.

cloze.s: Don't be ___. The snake can't hurt you.

exam.s: The little boy was frightened.

words.en: the way in which two things are not the same
words.ex: What's the difference between these two pictures?
words.exVi: Hai bức tranh này khác nhau chỗ nào?

cloze.s: Can you see the ___? One cat is black, one is white.

col.ok: the difference between A and B
bad: the difference among A and B
the difference of A with B

exam.s: There is one difference between the twins.
